english.title: Driver of vehicle fail to stop after vehicular accident at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was involved in an accident on a part of Bristol Airport which was not a public road, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), by which personal injury was caused or damage was caused to a vehicle, an animal or other property, failed to stop and give your name and address, the name and address of the owner of the vehicle, the registration number or identification marks of the vehicle and details of the accident to a Constable or Airport Official or any other person having reasonable grounds for requiring them, as soon as reasonably practicable but in any event, no later than 24 hours after the accident
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 8.1 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
